acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The code and the content are yours. We will not hold a site hostage to a retainer.
That depends what you want to edit. Text and images, yes. Reworking a page layout is design work, and pretending otherwise is how sites slowly fall apart.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a website builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: A builder gives you a category’s worth of layouts and stops where they stop. A custom build starts from what you sell and can do things the builder cannot — which only matters if you need those things.
It is a static-first build, so it runs on any modern host cheaply and fast. We will recommend one and set it up, or deploy to yours.
